summary: Iteration 52 — TeamNest Dev OS Phase 2 (Recursive Improvement Engine) end-to-end tested. All 10 new pytest backend tests passed: llm_status field present on project + proposal creation, scan endpoint returns correct shape with signal buckets (bug/ux/perf/missing/churn), scan auto-drafts proposals tagged created_by_agent='recursive_scan' with source_chat_id, 400 when no chat linked, 404 for unknown project, chat_id override works. Frontend Playwright flow verified: pd-scan + pd-new-proposal buttons render on /dev-os/projects/{id}; clicking Scan on a chat-linked project calls POST /dev-projects/{id}/scan (LIVE LLM — scanned 10 messages, 10 signals, 3 high-quality proposals drafted: lazy loading, Slack integration, churn retention workflow), switches to Proposals tab, and shows success toast 'Scanned 10 messages · 10 signals · 3 proposals drafted'. Clicking Scan on a project without related_chat_id correctly shows error toast and does NOT call the API. Iteration 51 regression: dashboard + agents smoke tests still pass; the 7 errors in test_iteration51 are NOT regressions — they're Cloudflare edge 502s from the public URL's ~100s timeout (LLM live calls now take longer than stub). Backend logs confirm those calls actually succeed; iter52 worked around this by hitting localhost:8001 for LLM-heavy paths.
action_items: (Infra, low-priority) Cloudflare edge has ~100s read timeout in front of the preview URL. Live LLM calls on POST /api/dev-projects routinely exceed that and bubble up as 502 to the browser even though the backend succeeds. Consider: (a) returning a 202 with a job_id and polling, or (b) streaming the response, or (c) raising the CF proxy timeout. Iter51 regression suite hits this; not a code defect.
critical_code_review_comments: services/recursive_improvement.py is clean — regex buckets ordered by priority (bug first, praise last), caps LLM at top 3 signals to control credit spend. Good.

routes/dev_os.py scan endpoint: when create_proposals=true, each LLM call is awaited sequentially in a loop. For projects with chats containing 5+ signal types, this serial loop can push total wall time well past CF's 100s. Recommend asyncio.gather() for the per-signal generate_proposal calls.
scan_chat_for_signals filters out praise signals — good, no proposals drafted for compliments. Worth documenting in the endpoint docstring.

ProjectDetail.jsx runScan handler: when scanning is in progress and the user hits Propose, both modal and scan-loader will be active. Minor — consider also disabling Propose while scanning (or vice versa) for symmetry.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 UI flows: render + scan-with-chat + scan-without-chat + proposals-tab-switch)

seed_data_creation: Created in dev_projects/improvement_proposals/chats collections (all prefixed TEST_iter52): one group chat with 10 signal-rich messages, one project linked to that chat ('TEST_iter52 project with chat'), one project without chat ('TEST_iter52 project no chat'). LIVE LLM drafted 3 real proposals on the linked project. Safe to leave; identifiable by TEST_iter52 prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is LIVE — generate_product_plan and generate_proposal return _llm_status='live' and credits ARE deducted (25 cr per plan, 5 cr per proposal). When LLM falls back to stub, NO credits are charged (verified by code review — both routes gate consume_credits behind `if _llm_status == 'live'`). Cloudflare 100s edge timeout is the only annoyance: any test that creates a project through the public URL will eat a 502 even though the backend succeeds. Workaround: use http://localhost:8001 for LLM-heavy POSTs. The iter51 test file still references the public URL — main agent may want to backport the internal_session pattern.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Cloudflare 502 noted above is infra, not code.
